items.name: Moonsilver Spear
entries: An angel of the Flight of Moonsilver wields a spear made from a shard of the Helvault. Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means. Once per turn, when the angel hits a creature with an attack using this weapon, it can wound the target. At the start of each of the wounded creature's turns, it takes {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage for each time the angel has wounded it, and it can then make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

monster.name: Creepy Doll
languages: speaks and understands the languages known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: Embora a boneca assustadora permaneça imóvel, ela é indistinguível de uma boneca inanimada comum.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: A boneca assustadora faz um ataque com sua tesoura e usa Ataque Psíquico.

action.name: Scissors
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} para acertar, alcance 5 pés, um alvo. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) cortando dano.

action.name: Psychic Assault
entries: A boneca assustadora tem como alvo uma criatura que ela possa ver a até 3 metros dela e que tenha cérebro. O alvo deve ter sucesso em um teste de resistência de Inteligência {@dc 12} ou sofrerá 11 ({@damage 2d10}) de dano psíquico. Também em caso de falha, role {@dice 3d6}. Se o total for igual ou superior ao valor de Inteligência do alvo, esse valor é reduzido para 0. O alvo é {@condition stunned} até recuperar pelo menos um ponto de Inteligência, como do feitiço {@spell greater restoration} ou magia similar.

action.name: Body Exchange
entries: A boneca assustadora inicia uma competição de Inteligência com um humanóide {@condition incapacitated} a até 1,5 metro dela. Se vencer o concurso, o espírito da boneca assustadora habita o corpo do alvo enquanto o espírito do alvo é colocado no corpo da boneca assustadora. A boneca assustadora controla completamente o corpo do alvo. Ele mantém seu alinhamento, Inteligência, Sabedoria, Carisma e imunidade a ser {@condition charmed} e {@condition frightened}. Caso contrário, ele usa as estatísticas do alvo possuído, mas não obtém acesso ao conhecimento, características de classe ou proficiências do alvo. O alvo mantém seu alinhamento, Inteligência, Sabedoria e Carisma enquanto habita o corpo da boneca assustadora.

A troca de corpos dura até que o espírito da boneca seja expulso por magia. (O feitiço {@spell dispel evil and good} fará isso, embora o boneco não seja um dos tipos de criatura cuja posse desse feitiço normalmente termina.) O corpo e o boneco devem estar a 1,5 metro um do outro para que tal efeito funcione. O alvo fica imune à Troca de Corpos desta boneca por 24 horas após vencer a competição de Inteligência ou após o término da troca.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The demon makes three melee attacks: two with its battleaxe and one with its tail. It can use Hurl Flame in place of any melee attack.

items.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) slashing damage, or 17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

items.name: Goldnight Menace
entries: As an action, an angel of Flight Goldnight can strike fear into the hearts of its enemies. Each creature of the angel's choice that is within 120 feet of it and is aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The DC for this saving throw is the same as for the angel's Innate Spellcasting trait. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to that angel's Goldnight Menace for the next 24 hours.

Once per turn, when the angel hits a creature with an attack using this weapon, it can wound the target. At the start of each of the wounded creature's turns, it takes {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage for each time the angel has wounded it, and it can then make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success. Alternatively, the wounded creature, or a creature within 5 feet of it, can use an action to make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check, ending the effect of such wounds on it on a success.

monster.name: Geist
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: O geist pode ver 18 metros no Plano Etéreo quando está no Plano Material e vice-versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: O geist pode se mover através de outras criaturas e objetos como se fossem {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Recebe 5 ({@dice 1d10}) de dano de força se terminar seu turno dentro de um objeto.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} para acertar, alcance 5 pés, um alvo {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) de dano necrótico.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: O geist entra no Plano Etéreo vindo do Plano Material, ou vice-versa. É visível no Plano Material enquanto está na Fronteira Etérea, e vice-versa, mas não pode afetar ou ser afetado por nada no outro plano.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: Uma criatura que o geist possa ver a até 1,5 metro dele deve ter sucesso em um teste de resistência de Carisma {@dc 13} ou será possuída pelo geist; o geist então desaparece, e o alvo é {@condition incapacitated} e perde o controle de seu corpo. O geist agora controla o corpo, mas não priva o alvo da consciência. O geist não pode ser alvo de nenhum ataque, feitiço ou outro efeito, exceto aqueles que expulsam mortos-vivos, e mantém seu alinhamento, Inteligência, Sabedoria, Carisma e imunidade a {@condition charmed} e {@condition frightened}. Caso contrário, ele usa as estatísticas do alvo possuído, mas não obtém acesso ao conhecimento, características de classe ou proficiências do alvo. A posse dura até que o corpo caia para 0 pontos de vida, o geist a termine como uma ação bônus, ou o geist seja expulso ou forçado a sair por um efeito como o feitiço {@spell dispel evil and good}. Quando a posse termina, o geist reaparece em um espaço desocupado a até 1,5 metro do corpo. O alvo fica imune à Possessão deste geist por 24 horas após ter sucesso no teste de resistência ou após o término da posse. Em vez disso, o geist pode atingir o cadáver de uma criatura, usando efetivamente sua própria força vital para animar o cadáver como um zumbi. O cadáver animado usa estatísticas de zumbis e retorna à morte se o geist encerrar a posse.

variant.name: Geist Powers
entries: Geists are as varied as the humans they were in life. In addition to the traits and actions all geists possess, an individual geist might have any of the following special characteristics.

entries.name: Intangible Virtue
entries: A living creature possessed by a white-aligned geist gains immunity to the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. While the creature is possessed, the geist can allow it to take control of its body, but the geist can regain control at any time (no action required).

entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Black-aligned geists can make themselves terrible to behold, even when they are possessing the living. Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the geist that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages {@dice 1d4 × 10} years. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this geist's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

items.name: Heron Protection
entries: Whenever an angel of the Host of Herons or a friendly creature within 10 feet of it makes a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to the angel's Charisma modifier. The angel must be conscious to receive or grant this bonus.

items.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage in raven form, or 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage in hybrid form.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The keeper is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

items.name: Heron Protection

variant.name: Skaabs
entries: The most basic skaabs are simply {@creature flesh golem|MM|flesh golems}, as described in the Monster Manual. But the aspiration of every skaberen is to produce a truly unique masterpiece, a goal that might see a stitcher create golems with one of the following special characteristics.

entries.name: Armor Plating
entries: Increase the skaab's Armor Class to 14 and increase its challenge rating to 6 (2,300 XP).

entries.name: Six Arms
entries: The skaab's multiattack action allows it to make three slam attacks. Increase its challenge rating to 6 (2,300 XP).

entries.name: Three Heads
entries: The skaab has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}. (Its challenge rating doesn't change.)

entries.name: Skaab Goliath
entries: This skaab has three heads, six arms, and armor plating. Increase its challenge rating to 7 (2,900 XP).

entries.name: Winged Skaab
entries: The skaab has a flying speed of 30 feet.

items.name: Three Heads
entries: The skaab has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The skaab makes three slam attacks.

items.name: Multiattack
entries: The skaab makes three slam attacks.

items.name: Three Heads
entries: The skaab has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition stunned}, and knocked {@condition unconscious}.

items.name: Vampire Vulnerabilities
entries: Weapons cut from living wood are particularly effective against vampires, though any weapon can harm or kill them. A vampire can't cross running water that shows the reflection of the moon, and water blessed by Avacyn ({@item Holy Water (flask)|PHB|holy water}) burns vampire flesh like acid. A vampire's reflection in silver (including a silver-backed glass mirror) appears as the vampire would have looked without the vampiric condition—neither its true appearance nor its glamer, but a normal human, flaws and all. For that reason, vampires go to great lengths to avoid mirrors, and the presence of silver in any form is unsettling to them.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks not made with living wood weapons

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: O vampiro recupera 10 pontos de vida no início do seu turno se tiver pelo menos 1 ponto de vida. Se o vampiro sofrer dano radiante ou de água benta, esta característica não funciona no início do próximo turno do vampiro.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: O vampiro faz dois ataques, dos quais apenas um pode ser um ataque de mordida.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} para acertar, alcance 1,5 m, uma criatura. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) dano cortante. Em vez de causar dano, o vampiro pode agarrar o alvo (escapar {@dc 13}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} para atingir, alcançar 1,5 m, uma criatura voluntária ou uma criatura que seja {@condition grappled} pelo vampiro, {@condition incapacitated} ou {@condition restrained}. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) de dano perfurante mais 7 ({@damage 2d6}) de dano necrótico. O máximo de pontos de vida do alvo é reduzido em uma quantidade igual ao dano necrótico recebido, e o vampiro recupera pontos de vida iguais a essa quantidade. A redução dura até o alvo terminar um descanso longo. O alvo morre se este efeito reduzir seu máximo de pontos de vida a 0.

action.name: Vampiric Glamer
entries: O vampiro obscurece sua forma com magia que afeta a mente, fazendo com que os outros o percebam como um belo ser humano do mesmo tamanho e forma. A ilusão termina se o vampiro realizar uma ação bônus para encerrá-la ou se o vampiro morrer. Uma criatura que pode ver o vampiro pode realizar uma ação para inspecioná-lo visualmente, encerrando o efeito mental sobre si mesma e vendo a verdadeira forma do vampiro com um teste bem-sucedido de {@dc 20} Sabedoria ({@skill Perception}).

action.name: Aura of Silence
entries: O vampiro se envolve em um manto de silêncio em um raio de 60 centímetros. Dentro desse raio, o efeito é o mesmo do feitiço {@spell silence}.

variant.name: Elder Vampires
entries: The basic vampire statistics represent a "neonate"—a newly spawned vampire. Older vampires can learn powerful magic of many different kinds, and might have any of the following traits and abilities.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: The vampire has the Shapechanger trait of the {@creature vampire} in the Monster Manual, as well as the shapechanger tag. Some vampires can turn into bat form, some can assume mist form, and a few can choose either form.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The vampire has the Charm action of the {@creature vampire} in the Monster Manual.

entries.name: Flight
entries: The vampire has a flying speed of 30 feet.

entries.name: Gorger
entries: The vampire has advantage on melee attack rolls, but attack rolls against it have advantage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The vampire has the spellcasting abilities of a wizard or cleric.

items.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

items.name: Gorger
entries: The vampire has advantage on melee attack rolls, but attack rolls against it have advantage.

items.name: Charm
entries: The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed} by the vampire. The {@condition charmed} target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: O lobisomem se transforma em uma forma canina lobo-humanóide ou volta à sua verdadeira forma humana. Essa mudança é ditada pela lua, mas também pode ser induzida por trauma ou emoção forte. Suas estatísticas, exceto seu AC, são as mesmas em cada formulário. Qualquer equipamento que esteja usando ou carregando não é transformado. Ele reverte à sua verdadeira forma se morrer.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: O lobisomem tem vantagem em testes de Sabedoria ({@skill Perception}) que dependem de audição ou olfato.

trait.name: Howlpack: Vildin
entries: Vildin Rampage (somente forma canina). Quando o lobisomem reduz uma criatura a 0 pontos de vida com um ataque corpo a corpo em seu turno, ele pode realizar uma ação bônus para se mover até metade de seu deslocamento e realizar um ataque de mordida.

action.name: Multiattack (Canid Form Only)
entries: O lobisomem faz dois ataques: um com a mordida e outro com as garras ou lança.

action.name: Bite (Canid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} para acertar, alcance 5 pés, um alvo. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) dano perfurante.

action.name: Claws (Canid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} para acertar, alcance 5 pés, um alvo. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) dano cortante.

action.name: Spear (Human Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} para acertar, alcance 5 pés ou alcance 20/60 pés, um alvo. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) de dano perfurante ou 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) de dano perfurante se usado com as duas mãos para fazer um ataque corpo a corpo.

variant.name: Howlpack Traits
entries: The basic werewolf statistics represent a member of the Krallenhorde, Innistrad's largest howlpack. Werewolves of other packs might have additional abilities such as the following.

entries.name: Vildin Rampage (Canid Form Only)
entries: When the werewolf reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a bite attack.

entries.name: Mondronen Wounded Fury
entries: While it has 10 hit points or fewer, the werewolf has advantage on attack rolls. In addition, it deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage to any target it hits with a melee attack.

entries.name: Leeraug Blood Frenzy
entries: The werewolf has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: Se o dano reduzir o gato a 0 pontos de vida, ele deve realizar um teste de resistência de Constituição com CD 5 + o dano recebido, a menos que o dano seja radiante ou de um acerto crítico. Com um sucesso, o gato cai para 1 ponto de vida.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: Se o dano reduzir o rato a 0 pontos de vida, ele deve realizar um teste de resistência de Constituição com CD 5 + o dano recebido, a menos que o dano seja radiante ou de um acerto crítico. Com um sucesso, o rato cai para 1 ponto de vida.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: Se o dano reduzir a cobra a 0 pontos de vida, ela deve realizar um teste de resistência de Constituição com CD 5 + o dano recebido, a menos que o dano seja radiante ou de um acerto crítico. Com um sucesso, a cobra cai para 1 ponto de vida.
